title: Survive the Night: The Lava Golem Knocked on My Door
description: Every night the wheel picks a monster. Tonight it stopped at my door at 5:59… what would you do?

scenes.narration: Every night at ten, the wheel decides which monster breaks out of the mountain.
Tonight, it's the Lava Golem. And the rule is simple: survive until six A M.
I grabbed my little sister and we ran home. Doors locked. Lights off.
Dad's only rule: if you can hear it breathing, it can hear you too.
At eleven, the first scream. Mister Peterson forgot to lock his door, and the whole street started running.
We hid under the window and held our breath. Every single step shook the whole house.
At two A M, it came down our street. Slowly. Checking every door. Three houses away. Then two.
Then the rain started. And lava hates rain.
It screamed so loud, every window in town cracked.
My sister grabbed my arm and whispered: it's not angry. It's freezing. It just needs somewhere dry.
At five fifty nine, the stomping stopped. Right outside our front door.
Then it knocked. Three times. Gently.
One minute until sunrise. Its fire was going out, it was shivering, and it was looking right at me.
The rule says never open the door. So what do I do? Open it, or wait one more minute? Tell me.
